query:
update sessions
                set last_seen_at = greatest(last_seen_at, $3),
                    idle_expires_at = least(expires_at, greatest(idle_expires_at, $4))
              where tenant_id = $1
                and session_id = $2
                and revoked_at is null
                and expires_at > $3
                and idle_expires_at > $3
